errors.evidence: The description begins with a nonsensical sentence, "Тясност Сцена Фотолит 2030-2050," which appears to be a hallucinated title and does not correspond to any text in the figure.

errors.text_span: Ниска Сцена на Съхранение, Ядрена Сцена на Съхранение, Природни Газ и Схериране на Батерии, както и Висока Цена на Фотоволтаици
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly names the scenarios shown on the x-axis. The actual scenarios are "Референтен сценарии", "Ниска Цена Съхранение", "Ниска цена фотоволтаици", "Висока Цена природен Газ / Ниска Цена батерии", and "Нулеви Въглеродни емисии". The description misnames most of them and hallucinates "Ядрена Сцена на Съхранение".

errors.text_span: Хоризонталната ос представлява различните години от 2030 до 2050
errors.evidence: This is an incomplete and misleading description of the x-axis. The horizontal axis is grouped by five different scenarios, and within each scenario, it shows the years 2030, 2040, and 2050. The description omits the primary grouping by scenario.

errors.text_span: Вертикалната ос показва енергията, изразена в Телу (ТЕЛ)
errors.evidence: The y-axis does not show energy in "Телу (ТЕЛ)". This unit is hallucinated, likely from misinterpreting "ТЕЦ" in the legend. The chart is a 100% stacked bar chart, so the y-axis represents percentage (%), ranging from 0 to 100 (though the axis extends to 120).

errors.text_span: Стойностите в стълбовете варират от 0 до 120 ТЕЛ
errors.evidence: The values on the y-axis scale range from 0 to 120. However, the total value for each stacked bar is 100 (representing 100% of the energy mix). The description incorrectly states the values *in the bars* go up to 120 and uses the incorrect unit "ТЕЛ".

errors.text_span: зелен – Ядрена, жълт – Ядрена, сив – Природни Газ, оранжев – Ви, ... зеленочени – Биомаса, матовочервено – Геотермални и бяло – Съхранение
errors.evidence: The mapping of colors to energy sources is almost entirely incorrect. For example, it states green is Nuclear when Nuclear is orange; it claims grey is Natural Gas when Coal (Въглища) is dark grey/black; it claims orange is Hydro (Ви) when Nuclear is orange and Hydro is blue. It also hallucinates a 'white' color for Storage.

errors.text_span: по-високите стълбове представляват по-високо производство на енергия
errors.evidence: This is incorrect. The chart is a 100% stacked bar chart, meaning all bars have the same height, representing 100% of the energy mix. They show the proportion of different energy sources, not the total amount of energy production.
The description fails to mention several energy sources listed in the legend, such as "Въглища (ТЕЦ)" (Coal) and misidentifies or misses others like "Природен Газ", "Геотермални", and "ВЕИ".
